seo.title: Custom Sport & Adventure Trips — You Imagine, We Create | OrganixEvents
seo.description: Tailor-made sport and adventure trips for private groups, families, clubs, teams and companies, organised end to end by Organix. Custom quotation.

start.title: Start with almost anything.
start.lead: You don't need a plan. You can come to us with:

organise.title: We build and run the whole project.

audiences.title: Built for your group.

groups.title: Corporate / Team building
groups.text: Days on the water — paddle, kayak, wakeboard, wakesurf, boat — with meals and activities alongside our local partners. For example, a team day on Lac de Joux.

groups.title: Private groups / Families
groups.text: A trip for your friends or your family, built around your pace and your ideas.

groups.title: Clubs / Sports teams
groups.text: Training camps and team trips, with the sport, the logistics and the time together all taken care of.

audiences.price: No price list: every project gets its own custom quotation.

inspiration.title: Possibilities, not packages.
inspiration.note: These are ideas, not scheduled trips. Each one would be built from scratch around your group.

steps.title: Tell us the idea
steps.text: However rough. A sport, a place, a group, a date.

steps.title: We shape it together
steps.text: We come back with options and talk them through with you.

steps.title: You go
steps.text: With one contact who knows every detail.

final.title: Start with an idea.
final.lead: Tell us what you have in mind. We create the rest.
